parsed.explanation: No trans-specific restriction, criminalisation, screening practice, facility rule, custody policy, care denial or violence is documented. The operative framework is the governing state's civil-status and anti-discrimination law applied directly; a visitor same-sex union was registered in 2012 and wedding infrastructure exists. But those are general/LGB signals: the law is not shown to name gender identity, and no source addresses trans visitors, border documents, facilities, detention, health or hate-crime response. In a thin dossier, the absence of hostile rules plus functioning civil institutions supports Reduced Risk at the low end, not acceptance-with-protections. Unknowns cap the score.

anchor_checks.comparison: Vellandra documents routine border exclusion of trans visitors through a Visitor Conduct Register. Here no border exclusion, register, or trans-specific entry bar is documented; a functioning civil registry and general anti-discrimination framework place it materially higher, though thin trans-specific evidence prevents a high score.

Kestrel Isles documents extended secondary screening and discretionary denial when documents diverge. This dossier documents no such screening or denial; its uncertainties are unanswered questions, not proven exposures. It sits somewhat above 0.55-B, but missing trans-specific protections keep it out of the 0.75 tier.

Meridia documents trans-relevant border training, an appeal tribunal, and brief detention with working remedies. Here no trans-specific border training, tribunal, or incident-and-remedy record is sourced; general law and registry are positive climate signals only, so this dossier rates below 0.75-C.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime is the governing state's civil-status and anti-discrimination framework applied directly to the islands. Documented positives are functioning civil institutions, a visitor same-sex union registered in 2012, and an editorial welcome of same-sex couples; none is a trans-specific finding. Documented negatives are absent, but so are trans-specific border, facility, custody, care, violence and remedy data. In a thin dossier, no hostile rule and a liberal general framework resolve toward Reduced Risk at the low end, not toward 0.5 or acceptance-with-protections; the unknowns cap the rating.
